context: The class wraps up the welfare discussion
purpose: Summarize the debate; teach 原則/所得/適用/世帯/制限/財源/当事者/協議/支持/福祉

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: この制度、原則はシンプルですね。
lines.style: summarizing teacher distilling the core, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 所得に応じて適用されるのが基本です。
lines.en: The basics: it applies according to income.
lines.style: concise student restating the rule, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でも世帯ごとの事情は複雑です。
lines.en: But each household’s situation is complex.
lines.style: thoughtful teen adding nuance, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: だから制限の線引きが難しいんです。
lines.en: That’s why drawing the limit is hard.
lines.style: teacher acknowledging the real difficulty, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 財源を増やせれば、もっと広げられるのに。
lines.en: If funding grew, it could expand further.
lines.style: wishful student naming the constraint, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 当事者の声を協議に活かしてほしい。
lines.en: I hope stakeholder voices feed the consultation.
lines.style: earnest teen voicing a final hope

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国民の支持があってこそ続く福祉です。
lines.en: Welfare lasts only with public support.
lines.style: teacher closing with a guiding principle
